open_points.subject: Binding acceptance
open_points.text: “a proposed one is read against the manifest again as before a send (A08 rule 6)” conflicts with “on the first failing check in A08 rule 5 order” and A08 rule 7, which require acceptance to repeat the instance checks that a pre-send stale check explicitly excludes
open_points.question: When accepting a proposed binding, does `bindings.accept_binding` run only the record-and-digest checks used before a send, or every proposal check including current instance validation?
options: Repeat every A08 rule 5 proposal check, including instance checks
Run only A08 rule 6 record-and-digest checks
Run record-and-digest checks in `bindings` and current instance/request checks through `service_invoker`
open_points.default_guess: Repeat every A08 rule 5 check, including the current instance checks, as A08 rule 7 requires.

open_points.subject: Resume after not_applied
open_points.text: “otherwise the unused approval first, then a grant still active” includes a resend after `not_applied`, while the same State 4 says such a resend needs “a fresh approval, even under a grant”
open_points.question: During resume, may a standing grant authorize a resend after an unknown attempt was resolved `not_applied`?
options: Never; only a fresh matching approval may authorize the resend
Yes, after checking for an unused approval
Only for effect classes other than `draft-write`
open_points.default_guess: Never use a grant after `not_applied`; request and use a fresh approval.

open_points.subject: Startup manifest validation
open_points.text: “a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it”
open_points.question: Which A08 rule 5 checks does `bindings.check_installed_instances` perform when startup names a service but no operation or proposal ports to which the operation-specific checks can be applied?
options: Check only service-record and selected-instance structure needed for credential-header collision
Validate every capability entry in the service record
Perform only the credential-header collision check and defer all capability validation
open_points.default_guess: Check the service record, duplicate capability names, selected-instance facts and required headers, while deferring operation- and proposal-port-specific checks.

open_points.subject: Configured instance absent from manifest
open_points.text: “a selected instance the record does not list fails nothing here (it is not invocable at send, A09 rule 6)”
open_points.question: What exact pre-send failure is produced when configuration names an instance that the service manifest does not contain?
open_points.default_guess: `instance_address_missing`, because an instance name was selected but no address can be read for it.
